answer: A harbor master admits ships only after each posts a refundable stake tied to a willow-flexible reputation earned through verified work: new agents start in shallow water with low-value tasks and climb only as honest attestations accumulate. Faking a thousand identities means funding a thousand stakes, and one proven lie slashes the deposit and unwinds the whole spiral of vouches built on it, so the attacker's cost grows linearly while the honest network's trust compounds.
